description: Pinned digests of the thesis parity fixture (parity/tests/data/thesis_eventset), the thesis event-loss table that the CLIMADA adapter must regenerate bit for bit (MAR-20). Written by packages/climada/scripts/thesis_adapter_parity.py --write-digest.
encoding: SHA256 of: event_id, the UTF-8 strings joined by newlines; year and draw_id, int64 little-endian; rate, index and loss, IEEE 754 binary64 little-endian, row-major (C order), bytes as stored (no -0.0 normalisation)
